purpose: Qualify the already selected vLLM #64830 candidate at source level to address the documented shortage of prospective Train/Development tasks. This protocol does not authorize a model or agent rollout, task assignment, training, or any Held-Out access, and does not change a frozen readiness gate.

frozen_readiness_gate.effect_of_this_protocol: none; qualification cannot change the gate or authorize training or rollout

pretest_freeze_requirement: After inspecting the pinned PR diff and selecting only the precise upstream regression test(s), create and commit an immutable addendum containing exact source/test hashes, baseline/fixed/mutant construction, test selectors, commands, isolation profile, and stop rules. Do not execute any candidate task test before that addendum is committed.
qualification_gate: Count this candidate as QUALIFIED_SOURCE_LEVEL only if the exact baseline fails at the intended regression assertion, an independently constructed wrong mutant is rejected by the same targeted assertion, the exact upstream-fixed source passes, all source/test hashes match, and all arms run in the same isolated CPU-only environment with network disabled. Otherwise preserve the result as NOT_QUALIFIED or UNSUPPORTED.

isolation_requirements.source: arm-specific immutable workspace; candidate source is the only writable project tree
isolation_requirements.trusted_test: separate read-only mount not visible through the candidate source tree

stop_rules: Verify all referenced frozen input hashes and the candidate metadata before source/test access; stop on any mismatch.
Do not access or enumerate Held-Out identities, task prompts, source, tests, or graders.
Do not expose candidate task content to any model or agent.
Run only test selectors frozen in the committed pretest addendum; no broad suite or unbounded dependency installation.
Stop an arm at 600 seconds, 8 GiB, any accelerator requirement, any network requirement during tests, or any isolation failure.
Do not retry a failed or unsupported arm without a new hash-bound addendum committed before retry.
claim_boundary: A successful result is source-level task and grader qualification only. It does not establish coding-agent capability, model freshness, a Train/Development assignment, RL readiness, held-out readiness, or learning improvement.
